about: One entry per shelf toy: the owner's review notes (2026-09-23, docs/reviews/2026-09-23/review.md), a verdict, and a proposed tap effect and sound. v: keep = the owner likes the effect as it is; more = it has an effect that should be clearer or more dramatic; new = it only hops today and needs its own effect. fix = a visual problem to fix. interactive = the owner asked for touch-position or drag interaction. Proposals are suggestions; the owner may change them. tools/toy-plan.mjs checks this file against the shelf and writes docs/TOY-PLAN.md. On 2026-09-24 the owner approved every proposal in this file as written, including the sports-ball texture fixes.

cactus.effect: Tiny flowers bloom on the spines, then close.
cactus.sound: Soft pluck with a dry rattle.

strawberry.effect: Seeds pop out and sparkle, then settle back; the berry blushes redder.

cookie.effect: The jam heart glows and throbs twice like a heartbeat.
cookie.sound: Short crunch and a soft double thump.

bee.owner: Now the right way up. Maybe flap its wings.
bee.effect: Wings buzz in a blur and the bee lifts off a little, then lands.

cluster-fly.owner: Right way up. Do what a fly does: rub its hands together, clean its face, flap its wings.
cluster-fly.effect: Front legs rub together, then the wings flick.

may-beetle.owner: Detail is great but underwhelming; it needs an effect.
may-beetle.effect: Wing cases lift and the fanned antennae spread, then fold.

millipede.owner: Great chance for all the legs to move and the body to stretch out.
millipede.effect: A leg wave ripples down the body while it stretches and curls.

bumblebee.effect: Fuzzy body shivers and the wings hum; a slow, clumsy hover.

raspberry.owner: Looks really cool; very good resolution.
raspberry.effect: The drupelets bounce one by one in a ripple.

blackberry.owner: Same as the raspberry: looks great.
blackberry.effect: Drupelets gleam in a wave, like light running over it.

blueberry.effect: The bloom (dusty coat) wipes off in a swirl, showing deep blue, then returns.

grape.owner: Looks good. Maybe the skin comes off.
grape.effect: The skin peels back in strips to show the pale flesh, then closes.

star-cookie.fix: Starts backwards: the bottom of the cookie faces the camera. Turn it round.
star-cookie.effect: Crumbles into pieces and crumbs, then reassembles.

tomatoes.owner: Fantastic, extremely realistic. Maybe they move around.
tomatoes.effect: The tomatoes roll and jostle each other, then settle.
tomatoes.sound: Soft thuds rolling on a table.

mandeltorus.owner: Some parts should rotate clockwise and others counterclockwise.
mandeltorus.effect: Rings of the fractal counter-rotate in bands, then lock back.

basket.owner: A basket of seashells. Neat. No effect.
basket.effect: Shells hop inside the basket one after another.

rubber-duck-real.owner: Squeeze and quack. It must differ from the other rubber duck.
rubber-duck-real.sound: Squeaky squeeze (high whistle) — the other duck quacks.

garden-gnome.owner: Hilarious, looks great. Maybe the lantern lights up, or it moves around.
garden-gnome.effect: The lantern lights with a warm glow and the gnome gives a little hop.
garden-gnome.sound: Tiny chuckle-like chirp plus a lamp click.

wooden-elephant.fix: Visually underwhelming; improve the look (re-convert at higher detail or pick a better CC0 model).
wooden-elephant.effect: Trunk lifts and it rocks on its wooden feet.
wooden-elephant.sound: Wooden knock and a toy trumpet.

marble-bust.owner: Looks good. Maybe the face moves and says something.
marble-bust.effect: The head turns to look at you; a speech bubble says a short Latin line.
marble-bust.sound: Stone grind and a low murmur.

ukulele.owner: Instruments should be played so music comes out.
ukulele.effect: Strings vibrate and it plays a short strum pattern.

alarm-clock.owner: Hands should move. On tap it should jump up and down and ring like an alarm clock.
alarm-clock.effect: Hands tick all the time; tap rattles it off the table while it rings.
alarm-clock.sound: Old twin-bell alarm ring (differs from the other alarm clock).

vintage-camera.fix: Grainy, almost like a reverse-contrast image; detail is lost. Check the mesh-to-splats texture handling (screenshot in docs/reviews/2026-09-23/).
vintage-camera.owner: Could snap a photo with the flash going off.
vintage-camera.effect: Flash burst from the camera and the view briefly whites out.

boombox.effect: Speakers pulse to a beat and the tape reels turn.

croissant-real.owner: Must do something different from the other croissant.
croissant-real.effect: Tears in half and steam puffs out.

carrot-cake.effect: A slice cuts out and lifts away, showing layers.

pomegranate.effect: Splits open to show glowing red seeds that spill a little.
pomegranate.sound: Crack and a scatter of beads.

lantern.owner: A flame should light up inside, like the other fire toys.
lantern.effect: A flame lights inside with a warm glow and flicker.

cat-statue.owner: Like the bust: the cat moves a bit.
cat-statue.effect: The head turns and the tail swishes once.
cat-statue.sound: Stone grind and a tiny mew.

chess-set.owner: Ideally playable. At least: a tap plays a real game, white against black, as a long animation.
chess-set.effect: Plays a famous public-domain game move by move; later, tap a piece then a square to move it.

horse-statue.fix: A little too bright; details are hard to see. Lower exposure or contrast.
horse-statue.effect: Rears up on its hind legs, then settles.
horse-statue.sound: Stone grind and a whinny-like whistle.

blob.owner: Interesting; no idea for an effect. The original shapes are really good-looking.
blob.effect: Splits into three small blobs that merge back.

donut.effect: Sprinkles jump off and rain back down.

knot.effect: The neon flows along the knot and it ties tighter, then relaxes.

planet.effect: Clouds race around and a day-night band sweeps over it.

basketball.owner: Balls look good. Bouncing is fine but each should bounce differently.
basketball.effect: Dribble: fast low bounces, then a spin on a fingertip.
basketball.fix: Check the texture: it should read as pebbled rubber with clean black channels, not grain.

soccer-ball.effect: Keepy-uppy: three small kicks with spin.
soccer-ball.fix: Check the texture: smooth panels with clean seams, not speckle.

american-football.effect: A tight spiral spin in place.
american-football.fix: Looks grainy, not like leather. Give it a pebbled pigskin leather texture (fine bumps, subtle sheen, darker seams and crisp white laces).
american-football.owner: The owner (2026-09-24): some sports balls look grainy rather than realistic; the tennis ball should be fuzzy and the American football should look like leathered pigskin. Look at the other balls too.

tennis-ball.effect: Fast high bounce with the fuzz fluffing out.
tennis-ball.fix: Should look fuzzy. Make the felt soft and fibrous (fine hair-like noise, slightly blurred edge) with a clean white seam.
tennis-ball.owner: The owner (2026-09-24): some sports balls look grainy rather than realistic; the tennis ball should be fuzzy and the American football should look like leathered pigskin. Look at the other balls too.

baseball.effect: Curveball: it spins hard and swerves.
baseball.fix: Check the texture: smooth white leather with crisp red stitches, not grain.

softball.effect: Underhand arc and a softer thud.
softball.fix: Check the texture: smooth leather with crisp red stitches, not grain.

beach-ball.effect: Floats up slowly, drifts and bobs down.

golf-ball.effect: Tiny chip hop and a spin-back.

rugby-ball.effect: Tumbles end over end with an odd bounce.
rugby-ball.fix: Check the texture: pebbled grip, not grain.

volleyball.effect: A set then a spike straight down.
volleyball.fix: Check the texture: smooth leather panels with clean seams, not speckle.

water-polo-ball.effect: Bobs on an invisible water line with ripples.

cricket-ball.fix: Check the texture: polished red leather with a shine and a clear raised seam.

pool-ball.effect: Clicks forward and spins with back-spin.

pickleball.effect: Light pop-up with air whistling through the holes.

medicine-ball.effect: Barely lifts and lands with a heavy squash.
medicine-ball.fix: Check the texture: matte rubber grip, not grain.

squash-ball.fix: Hard to see on the dark background (it is black). Consider a faint rim light in dark mode.
squash-ball.owner: Weird; hard to see on dark.
squash-ball.effect: Warms up: glows faintly as it bounces faster.

bouncy-ball.effect: Wild ricochet bounces all over, then home.

marble.effect: Rolls around a little circle; the swirl inside turns.

hockey-puck.fix: Hard to see on the dark background.
hockey-puck.effect: Slides and spins flat, throwing up ice sparkle.

shuttlecock.effect: Flips over and floats down feathers-up.

flying-disc.fix: Could use more texture; make it look more like plastic (sheen).

heart.effect: Racing heartbeat: faster beats with a glow, then calms.

brain.effect: Sparks of light race across the folds (a thought).

eye.owner: Pupil dilation is cool but underwhelming. Let the eye look around by itself, and use a different tap animation.
eye.effect: Idle: the eye looks around. Tap: it blinks, looks at you and the pupil snaps small.

lungs.effect: A deep breath in and out.

tooth.owner: Looks good; no idea for an effect.
tooth.effect: A sparkle wipe cleans it bright white.

kidney.effect: Fluid flows through in pulses along the vessels.

lava-lamp.fix: Refine where the glass meets the top and bottom caps.
lava-lamp.owner: Moves really well. On tap: blobs move faster, light up or change colours.
lava-lamp.effect: Blobs speed up, glow and shift colour for a few seconds.

ice-statue.owner: Let the little white specks move. The swan could melt or break apart.
ice-statue.effect: Specks drift; tap melts the swan into drips, then it refreezes.

candle.owner: Pretty good; OK as it is.
candle.sound: Soft blow and a match strike.

tornado.effect: Spins up bigger and faster, pulling debris, then weakens.

rainbow.effect: The arc draws itself colour by colour and sparkles at the ends.

iceberg.effect: A chunk calves off and splashes; the berg bobs.

waterfall.effect: A surge: the flow doubles and mist billows.

ocean-wave.effect: The wave curls and breaks into foam.

geyser.sound: Hiss and a whoosh of steam.

book.fix: Blurry: the text is just grey smudges and the cover is soft. Try readable text (a bitmap font), crisper page splats and a sharper cover (screenshots in docs/reviews/2026-09-23/).
book.owner: Blurry; try to make it more detailed so the writing looks like something.

laptop.owner: Pretty awesome; keep it the same.
laptop.sound: Keyboard clatter and a start-up chime.

music-box.owner: Animation is basically perfect; it needs music.
music-box.sound: A music-box melody (plucked comb tones) while open.

clock.owner: Does roughly what the scan alarm clock should do; keep them slightly different.
clock.sound: Modern digital-ish ring (different from the scan's twin bells).

sun.owner: Incredible. It should pulse and churn by default, dramatically, like the real Sun. Needs a super effect.
sun.effect: Idle: stronger churning and pulsing. Tap: a big solar flare loops off the surface.

solar-system.owner: Really cool. Maybe the planets line up for an eclipse.
solar-system.effect: Planets swing into a line and one eclipses the Sun, then orbits resume.

mercury.effect: Quick orbit-like spin and heat shimmer on the day side.

venus.effect: The thick clouds swirl fast around it.

earth.effect: Night side lights up with city lights as it turns; clouds move.

moon.effect: Cycles through phases, full to new and back.

mars.effect: A dust storm sweeps across it.

jupiter.effect: Bands race and the Great Red Spot spins up.

saturn.owner: The rings should move by default.
saturn.effect: Idle: rings turn. Tap: ring particles sparkle and ripple outward.

uranus.owner: Rings move a little by default too.
uranus.effect: Idle: slow ring motion. Tap: it rolls on its side.

neptune.effect: A dark storm and fast white clouds race by.

aurora-planet.owner: The auroras should actually move, realistically and dynamically.
aurora-planet.effect: Idle: auroras ripple as curtains. Tap: a bright surge of green and violet.

asteroid.owner: Pretty neat. Maybe it breaks into pieces.
asteroid.effect: Cracks and breaks into pieces that drift apart, then pull back together.
asteroid.sound: Rock crack and a low boom.

comet.fix: Overhaul: too blurry and not recognisable as a comet. Needs a bright icy nucleus, a coma and two distinct tails (straight blue ion tail, curved dusty tail). The meteor is closer to what the owner wants.
comet.owner: Extremely underwhelming; does not look like a comet.
comet.effect: Tail flares longer and brighter as it swings by.

meteor.effect: Streaks in and bursts in a fireball.

star.owner: Dynamic like the Sun. Maybe a solar flare, or it evolves into a dying star and dies.
star.effect: Tap runs a life cycle: swells into a red giant, puffs off its shell and leaves a white dwarf, then reforms.

pulsar.owner: Really neat; needs a really cool effect.
pulsar.effect: Beams sweep faster and faster with strobing flashes.

black-hole.owner: Almost perfect as it is; add an effect.
black-hole.effect: A small star falls in, gets stretched into a spiral and swallowed; the disk flares.

star-cluster.owner: Extremely cool; no idea for an effect.
star-cluster.effect: Stars twinkle in a wave and the cluster breathes in and out.

planetary-nebula.effect: The ring expands and glows brighter, then settles.

nebula.effect: New stars ignite inside the clouds.

supernova.owner: Outstanding; keep it as it is.
supernova.sound: Huge boom with a long tail.

spiral-galaxy.owner: No clear effect; it should rotate like a spiral galaxy.
spiral-galaxy.effect: Idle: slow rotation. Tap: arms swirl faster and the core flares.

virus.effect: Spikes wave and it splits into copies that fade away.

bacteriophage.owner: Tapping does nothing visible. Upgrade it.
bacteriophage.effect: Make the injection obvious: the legs splay, the sheath contracts a lot further and a glowing DNA strand shoots out of the tail.

bacterium.effect: Divides in two (binary fission), then merges back.

red-blood-cell.owner: Maybe turn into a sickle cell, if that is realistic.
red-blood-cell.effect: Deforms into a sickle shape (as in sickle-cell disease at low oxygen), then relaxes back to a disc.

neuron.owner: Decent effect but should be more dramatic.
neuron.effect: A bright pulse runs from the dendrites down the whole axon and bursts at the terminals.

astrocyte.effect: Calcium wave: a glow ripples out along its arms.

animal-cell.owner: Show some process going on inside, like replication.
animal-cell.effect: Cell division: the nucleus splits and the cell pinches into two, then rejoins.

dna.owner: Unzip even further, then zip back up. Almost perfect otherwise.
dna.effect: Unzips all the way, bases light up in pairs, then zips back.

white-blood-cell.effect: Chases and engulfs a small bacterium (phagocytosis).

microglia.effect: Arms reach out and sweep, then retract.

diatom.effect: The glass shell glints and splits into two halves.

tardigrade.owner: Looks great; the effect is awesome.

pollen.effect: Bursts a puff of tiny grains.

snowflake.owner: Melt it, or change into another shape.
snowflake.effect: Arms regrow into a new pattern each tap.

chromosome.effect: The sister chromatids pull apart at the centromere, then rejoin.

mitochondrion.owner: The powerhouse of the cell; make the effect about that.
mitochondrion.effect: The cristae light up and energy sparks (ATP) pop out.

paramecium.effect: Cilia beat in waves and it swims a loop.

amoeba.effect: Pushes out a pseudopod and oozes over.

orbital.effect: Jumps to a higher orbital shape with a glow, then drops back and flashes.

atom.effect: Electrons speed up into blurred shells.

molecule.effect: Bonds vibrate and stretch (like heat), then calm.

crystal-lattice.effect: A wave of vibration travels through the lattice.

diamond.effect: Fire: rainbow sparkles flash off the facets as it turns.

emerald.effect: Green light runs along the step cuts.

amethyst-geode.effect: The geode opens wider and the crystals glow violet.

sapphire.effect: A star shimmer (asterism) glides across it.

quartz-cluster.effect: Points light up one by one.

opal.effect: Colour play: flashes of colour roll across it.

crystal-ball.owner: Hard to tell what the effect is; make it clearer and more dramatic.
crystal-ball.effect: Mist swirls hard and a glowing shape appears inside, then fades.

oak.owner: Shake it and leaves come out.

pine.owner: Christmas lights and a star appear.
pine.effect: Shakes off a dusting of snow (approved instead of lights, which the decorated tree already has).

palm.owner: Tap it and the coconuts fall.
palm.effect: The coconuts fall and bounce, then regrow.

cherry-blossom.owner: Really cool already. Maybe all the blossoms fall off when touched.
cherry-blossom.effect: All the petals fall in a flurry, then it blooms again.

maple.owner: Same kind of thing as the cherry blossom.
maple.effect: Leaves swirl down in a spiral gust (different from the cherry's gentle fall).

bonsai.effect: Grows a new branch, then the scissors snip it back.

willow.effect: The long branches sway in a wave like a breeze passing.

sunflower.effect: The head turns to face the sun and petals open wide.

rose.effect: Blooms open further, a petal drops.

tulip.effect: Petals open wide to the sun, then close.

daisy.effect: Petals spin like a pinwheel (loves me, loves me not).

lotus.effect: The flower rises and opens on the water with ripples.

mushroom.effect: Puffs a cloud of glowing spores.

saguaro.owner: The spines come out, or it is cut in half to show the cactus water inside.
saguaro.effect: The spines shoot out and back; a second tap shows a cut-away with the watery inside.

coral.effect: Polyps open and little fish dart out and back.

pinecone.effect: The scales open wide (as in dry weather) and seeds drift out.

acorn.effect: The caps pop off and a sprout pokes out.

succulent.effect: The rosette opens and a small flower stalk rises.

bamboo.effect: Shoots grow tall very fast, segment by segment.

rocks.effect: The pebbles drop and scatter, then stack into a cairn.

kelp.owner: Maybe fish eat it; pick something.
kelp.effect: Fish swim in and nibble; the kelp sways away.

ice-cream.owner: Really neat; I like that you can melt it. Make melting part of the tap effect.
ice-cream.effect: Tap melts it: drips run down the cone, then it refreezes.

watermelon.owner: Cut it in half or into slices.
watermelon.effect: Cuts into slices that fan out.

birthday-cake.sound: Party blower and a cheer-like chime.

cupcake.effect: A cherry drops on top and sprinkles rain down.

lollipop.effect: Spins fast and the swirl hypnotises.

candy-cane.effect: The stripes wind around like a barber pole, then it snaps in two and rejoins.

macarons.effect: They stack themselves into a tower.

gummy-bear.owner: Underwhelming. Press, hold and drag to stretch its arm or body, and let go to spring back with realistic physics.
gummy-bear.effect: Drag to stretch (like the Magnet, with springy release); tap does a jelly jiggle.

pretzel.owner: Some sort of twisting, like the knots.
pretzel.effect: Untwists into a rope and twists back.

croissant.owner: Must differ from the real croissant.
croissant.effect: Puffs up in an oven glow (rising), then flakes fly off.

sushi.owner: Chopsticks lifted by an invisible hand pick up the sushi.
sushi.effect: Chopsticks pick up a roll, dip it and put it back.

taco.owner: Break in half to show what is inside. Really cool taco.
taco.effect: Shell cracks in half and the filling spills out, then it reassembles.

coffee.owner: Needs work. The cream on top could spin in a swirl on tap.
coffee.effect: Latte art swirl spins; steam curls up.

apple.owner: A bite taken out of it, or a worm comes out.
apple.effect: A bite appears (crunch); a second tap, a worm peeks out.

orange.effect: Splits into segments that fan out.

kiwi.effect: Halves open to show the green inside and seeds.

cherries.effect: The pair swings and bounces on its stems.

grapes.effect: Grapes drop off the stem and bounce, then return.

avocado.effect: Splits open and the stone pops out and back.

bricks.owner: Build something random from the blocks.
bricks.effect: Bricks rearrange into a random small build (tower, bridge, animal), different each tap.

rubber-duck.owner: Effect is OK; it needs a quack.

dice.owner: Maybe my favourite; rolls feel random like real dice. Keep it.

newtons-cradle.owner: Tapping has no noticeable effect. Make it more interactive.
newtons-cradle.effect: Tap lifts and drops an end ball hard so the clacks are obvious; later, drag a ball back and let go.

puzzle-cube.owner: Only the top row twists (very cool). Move more than the top row; ideally swipe any row or column to solve it; add a shuffle.
puzzle-cube.effect: Tap scrambles with several random layer turns. Later: swipe a face to turn that layer, with a solved check.

kite.effect: A big gust: the kite loops the loop and the tail whips.
kite.sound: Wind gust and a fabric flap.

lorenz.owner: Spin a little more or be more dynamic; looks good when still.
lorenz.effect: A glowing point races along the trail, drawing a new path.

mobius.owner: Wow, really neat. Maybe twist a little.
mobius.effect: An ant-like dot walks the single side; the band twists.

klein-bottle.owner: Not sure it has an effect. Maybe water flows through it; it already kind of does, make that dramatic.
klein-bottle.effect: A clear surge of water flows through the neck and round.

menger-sponge.owner: No idea for an effect; looks good. The owner calls one of these a favourite and a likely homepage embed (the transcript may refer to the next toy, the hypercube).
menger-sponge.effect: Zooms into itself: the holes open to show the next level down.

hypercube.owner: Possibly the favourite and homepage embed (see the Menger sponge).
hypercube.effect: Rotates through the fourth dimension, turning inside out.

gyroid.effect: The surface flows and shifts phase like a breathing sponge.

mandelbulb.effect: Morphs through powers (bulb shapes twist and bloom).

seashell-spiral.owner: Something to do with hearing the ocean in a seashell.
seashell-spiral.effect: Glows softly and waves ripple out of the opening.

shield.owner: Only bounces; find a better effect.
shield.effect: Blocks an invisible hit: it jolts, sparks and the emblem gleams.

crown.effect: Jewels light up in turn and it rises with a glow.

wizards-orb.owner: Looks really good; develop it further to be more impressive.
wizards-orb.effect: A bigger spell: runes orbit, light bursts and sparks spiral out.

jellyfish.owner: Not sure what the effect does; make it more apparent.
jellyfish.effect: A strong pulse that jets it upward, trailing glowing tentacles.

fish-school.owner: Swim around more dynamically, like a swarm.
fish-school.effect: The school swirls into a bait ball and scatters.

pufferfish.owner: Should puff: get big, then small.
pufferfish.effect: Inflates to a big spiky ball, then deflates.

nautilus.effect: Tentacles pull into the shell, then peek back out.

snail.owner: Perfect, but it disappears too much when hiding; make it more elegant.
snail.effect: Keep hiding in the shell, but keep the shell clearly visible and ease in more gently.

octopus.owner: Underwhelming; the ink should be much bigger and more dramatic.
octopus.effect: A big ink cloud billows out while it jets away and back.

sea-urchin.effect: Spines ripple in waves and it creeps along.

frog.owner: Mouth opens and the tongue shoots out.
frog.effect: Tongue shoots out to catch a fly.

snowman.owner: Do more than bounce; maybe it melts.
snowman.effect: Melts into a puddle, then rebuilds itself.

fireworks.owner: Outstanding. Make each launch different (like the dice), and the burst match the colour of the cannon that fires it.
fireworks.effect: Random shell types each tap; burst colour matches its tube.

decorated-tree.fix: The star on top looks like a glowing golden cloud; make it a clear star shape.
decorated-tree.owner: Lights only show very briefly; make it more dramatic.
decorated-tree.effect: Lights come on and chase in patterns and stay on; the star glows.

paper-lantern.owner: Perfect; the physics are really good.

diya.fix: Underwhelming visually; add detail (patterned clay, oil sheen).
diya.effect: The flame grows and a ring of small diyas lights around it.

guitar.effect: Keep the strum; strings vibrate visibly.
guitar.sound: A real strummed chord progression (synth plucks).

drum.owner: Could be more dramatic. Fast taps could play longer and faster rolls.
drum.effect: Sticks play a roll; fast repeated taps make faster, longer rolls.

xylophone.sound: The scale it already plays, as mallet tones.

hot-air-balloon.owner: Could be more dramatic; maybe inflate more.
hot-air-balloon.effect: Burner roars, the envelope swells and it rises higher.

sports-car.fix: A little small in its frame (known issue).

bus.owner: Not sure what the effect is.
bus.effect: Stop sign swings out, lights flash, doors open.

jet.owner: Very solid; bank more to one side or the other.
jet.effect: Climbs and banks hard left then right.

sailboat.owner: Pretty good; a bit more dramatic.
sailboat.effect: A big gust heels it over with spray.

submarine.owner: Underwhelming that only the periscope appears and disappears.
submarine.effect: Dives with bubbles, then surfaces and raises the periscope.

bicycle.owner: Not sure what the effect is; make it more dramatic.
bicycle.effect: Pedals spin, the wheels turn and the bell rings clearly.

tractor.fix: The exhaust smoke is heavy (known issue).

eiffel-tower.effect: Sparkling lights run up the tower and fireworks burst around it.

washington-monument.effect: The reflecting pool shimmers and the flags wave.

pyramids.owner: Neat. Maybe put a UFO there, as a joke.
pyramids.effect: A tiny UFO (the Flying saucer) hovers over the Great Pyramid and beams up a camel-shaped cloud of sand.

supertall.effect: The tower twists further and its lights run upward.

statue-of-liberty.fix: The crown looks squashed down; raise its rays and give them clearer spikes (screenshot in docs/reviews/2026-09-23/).
statue-of-liberty.owner: Everything else looks fine. Make the effect a good one.
statue-of-liberty.effect: The torch flame flares bright and sparkles drift from it.
statue-of-liberty.sound: Flame whoosh and a harbour bell.

white-house.effect: The fountain on the lawn sprays higher and the flag raises.

leaning-tower.owner: Lean further and things fall off, like Galileo dropping objects.
leaning-tower.effect: Two balls of different sizes drop from the top and land together.
leaning-tower.sound: Two thuds at the same time.

colosseum.effect: Non-violent: a tiny chariot race loops the arena while the crowd cheers (no fighting, per the no-gore rule).

parthenon.effect: Tiny robed figures walk between the columns in procession.

stonehenge.effect: Solstice sunrise: the sun rises through the stones and lights them gold.

big-ben.owner: No visible effect; make it pronounced or pick something better.
big-ben.effect: Hands spin to the hour, the clock face glows and the bell swings.

taj-mahal.effect: Moonlight: the dome glows and the reflecting pool ripples.

castle.owner: Pretty good but underwhelming. Knights come out when the drawbridge opens.
castle.effect: The drawbridge drops and tiny knights march out with a banner.

pagoda.owner: Not sure what the effect is.
pagoda.effect: Wind chimes swing on every roof tier and lanterns light up.

windmill.owner: Pretty good, but move a little faster.
windmill.effect: Faster sails; the gust spins them up hard.
